items.html: And behold, at night, which is like the time of nursing for ZA, the Nukva too is in the first emanation. And behold, her nine points, after midnight, join with Leah, as mentioned elsewhere; see there. And the point of the Keter, from the beginning of emanation, descended into BYA (Beriah, Yetzirah, Assiyah) to shine there. And by means of the occupation with Torah, she too ascends little by little, until, at the light of morning, she completes her ascent face to face in the left arm of ZA. And then the impression (Reshimu) of her mochin enters her, in the secret of the prayer of the Tefillin of the hand. And the nine points then descend into BYA.
